about: Employer boards that listed postings located in mainland China when each was read through its connector on 2026-10-11 (the parity wave, docs/jobright-clone/orch/handoffs-par/PAR-7.md item 4: the documented public posting API answered 200 and at least one posting resolved to mainland China). Nothing here is typed from memory. companyName is the board's own metadata where the job-board system states one (Greenhouse, SmartRecruiters); Lever and Ashby state none, so the board id is used as written and an admin may correct it. A board is one source for both sites: Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby boards are read whole (countries is empty: one request lists everything and each posting lands in the market of its own location); a SmartRecruiters board is listed per country, so it names the countries it is read for. The count in each note is what was measured that day, never a live number.
